cd /Users/carter/dev/approval-md/.claude/worktrees/aprv-112-records-tier && git add .github/workflows/ci.yml README.md scripts/classify-tier.mjs scripts/run-tests.mjs tests/ci-guard.test.ts tests/classify-tier.test.ts && git commit -F - <<'MSG'
APRV-112: a records tier for backlog-only diffs

Record-only changes ran the full 1800-test matrix on two Node majors
because backlog/** is on the force-full denylist. That denylist entry
exists because task files are instruction-bearing, and the argument it
actually supports is that every test which READS a record must run, not
that every test must run. So the classifier gains a third tier.

- classify-tier.mjs: RECORDS_ALLOWLIST (backlog/**, MILESTONES.md) and a
  `records` verdict, chosen only when every changed path is a record.
  Mixed sets escalate through the unchanged denylist, and the empty set,
  an unreadable git state and any unparseable path stay full.
- run-tests.mjs: `--only <name>...` selects a named subset through the
  same discovery, and a name matching no built file is a hard failure
  rather than a quietly smaller run.
- ci.yml: a `records` job running the three record-reading guards on the
  Node floor, gated on the computed tier like the light tier is, and the
  `ci` aggregator treats a skipped `records` as failure via a new case.
  merge_group and push-to-main still short-circuit to full.
- tests: records verdicts and refusals pinned; ci-guard asserts the job's
  test set equals the classifier's list, its Node version, the --only
  refusal, and the merge_group rule (previously untested).

MILESTONES.md is in the records set because its one reader in the repo,
tests/milestones-guard.test.ts, checks it against backlog/ in the same
assertions; splitting the pair across tiers would let half a rename skip
the guard.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
MSG
